en: The One Hundred and Eight Names of the Great Cakravartin:
O Vajrasattva, Great Vajra, Lord of Vajras, Excellent Accomplisher;
O Vajra-Initiation, Vajra-Luster, Vajra-Banner—homage be to you! (1)
O Laughing Vajra, Great Dharma, Vajra Treasury, Great Excellence, Supreme King of all Maṇḍalas, Free from conceptual proliferation—homage be to you! (2)
O Vajrakarma, great protector, fierce yakṣa, great graha;
O Vajramuṣṭi, great seal, you who are all seals, homage be to you! (3)
O Bodhicitta, great enlightenment! O Buddha, all Tathāgatas! O Vajrayāna, great gnosis, Great Vehicle! Homage be to you! (4)
O you who are all things, the meaning of all reality, and the purpose of all great beings;
O all-knowing one, the doer of all, the all, the seer of all—homage be to you! (5)
O you whose nature is vajra, supreme among the excellent vajras, vajra-valour, bearer of the excellent vajra;
O great pledge, essence of reality, great truth—homage be to you! (6)
O Vajrāṅkuśa, great desire, most radiant in divine passion;
O Vajraprabha, illuminating light, radiance of the Buddhas—homage be to you! (7)
O Supreme King of Vajras, O Foremost Vajra, O Foremost among the Foremost of Vidyās, O Best of Men! O Supreme Vajra, O Foremost among the Great Foremost, O Supreme Vidyā—homage be to you! (8)
O Vajradhātu, Great Secret, Vajra-secret, Holder of the well-hidden secret;
O Vajrasūkṣma, Great Meditation, Vajra-activity, homage be to you! (9)
O foremost of Buddhas, O foremost of Buddha-Vajras, O Greatly Awakened One regarding the awakening of the Buddhas;
O Buddha-Wisdom, O Great Buddha, O Buddha of Buddhas—homage be to you! 10.
O worshiper of the Buddhas, the Great Worship, and the excellent worshiper of sentient beings;
O Great Means, O Great Siddha—homage be to you, Vajrasiddhi! 11.
O Tathāgata of the great body, O Tathāgata of eloquence, O Tathāgata of the great mind, O Vajra-mind, homage be to you! 12.
O Lord of Buddhas, executor of the Victor’s command, friend of the Buddhas, eldest-born of the Victors, all-pervading Mahāvairocana, peaceful and fierce one—homage be to you! (13)
O Great Reality of the Tathāgata, O Great Method at the limit of existence, O Knowledge of all the perfections, O Ultimate Truth—homage be to you! (14)
Samantabhadra, supreme in conduct, Mara, sun that destroys the Maras, foremost of all, knowledge of equality, omnipresent—homage be to you! 15.
O Buddha-huṃkāra, Huṃkāra, Vajra-huṃkāra, Tamer;
O you whose limbs are the universal vajra, fierce vajra, Vajrapāṇi—homage be to you! 16.
You are to be saluted, worshipped, honored, and likewise revered by the Tathāgatas;
because your mind is as firm as a vajra, you are called Vajrasattva. (17)
For perfect enlightenment depends upon you; you are the father of all those who see all things.
Having approached you, Tathāgatas have arisen and will continue to arise. (18)

Whoever should praise [the deity] with this king of hymns with true devotion, or whoever should praise while singing it, he too shall become equal to the wielder of the thunderbolt (Vajradhara). || 19 ||
We entreat you, O Lord, who brings all Buddhas under your sway:
for the sake of accomplishing the welfare of all sentient beings, manifest your own family. (20)
The hymn of supplication consisting of one hundred and eight names of the Great Cakravartins is complete.
